summary_bullets: Make terminal self-composed final-summary fallbacks visibly distinguishable from full renderer output
Add a versioned fallback HTML marker while preserving the existing run-summary marker and first-line outcome heading
Extend design and implement harnesses to pin marker placement and ensure successful cost-unavailable retry output stays unmarked
Document the fallback contract in script docs and SECURITY.md
commit_message: Mark degraded final-summary fallbacks\n\nAdd visible fallback banners and machine-readable markers to terminal self-composed final-summary bodies, with tests and docs covering placement and retry discrimination.
